name: Yizhousaurus
sum: Yizhousaurus is a basal sauropodiform from the Early Jurassic Lufeng Formation of Yunnan, China, known from a nearly complete skeleton with an intact skull.
wsnote: No body length was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Found in 2002 and excavated in October-November of that year; a nearly complete, exquisitely preserved skeleton.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
